data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorers
data.description: Practice reading blocks and identifying place values in four-digit numbers, including numbers with interior zeros.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones carefully from left to right.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Remember to check each column value, starting with the thousands block.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look closely at the ones column. Are there any ones blocks present?

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the hundreds flats and tens rods to find the correct total value.
